# StoneQR

> Free, open-source (MIT) QR code generator that runs entirely in the browser. Codes are computed on the user's device, never uploaded, and cannot expire or be deactivated. Built for print: vector SVG, PDF (CMYK), and EPS exports with real millimetre dimensions, a print-size and scan-distance calculator, logos in the middle with a coverage cap, artistic QR codes (a photo blended through the whole code), bulk generation with Avery label sheets, and a decode check before every download.

Site: https://stoneqr.app · Source: https://github.com/malignantz/stoneqr · Privacy: nothing typed leaves the browser.

## Pages

- [Generator](https://stoneqr.app/): URL, text, WiFi, vCard, MeCard, email, SMS, phone, event, and location codes with size, colour, shape, logo, and frame controls.
- [Why these codes never expire](https://stoneqr.app/never-expires): static codes versus the "dynamic" codes that free-trial generators switch off.
- [WiFi QR code](https://stoneqr.app/wifi): guests join a network by pointing a camera; the password is encoded locally.
- [vCard QR code](https://stoneqr.app/vcard): a contact card people can save in one tap.
- [Event QR code](https://stoneqr.app/event): a calendar event in a code, with notes on which phones offer to add it.
- [QR code with logo](https://stoneqr.app/logo): error correction raised automatically, coverage capped, download decode-checked.
- [Artistic QR code](https://stoneqr.app/photo): a photo or built-in shape drawn through the modules of the whole code.
- [Print size calculator](https://stoneqr.app/print-size): module size, minimum width, and scan distance from the 10:1 rule.
- [Bulk and label sheets](https://stoneqr.app/bulk): paste a list or open a CSV; ZIP download or Avery label PDF.
- [Compare generators](https://stoneqr.app/compare): expiry, sign-up, vector export, error correction, and where data goes, side by side.
- [Open source](https://stoneqr.app/open-source): MIT licence, engine and site.
- [Privacy](https://stoneqr.app/privacy): two paragraphs.

## Engine

`@stoneqr/engine` is pure TypeScript with no DOM dependency: encode, payloads, sizing math, SVG/PDF/EPS/PNG export, halftone rendering, label geometry, and decode verification. It runs in Node, Workers, and browsers.
